description:
From: Elixir Parity (proposal); wording by Coordinator. User-approved 2026-11-24.

Evidence: .agent/docs/exceptions.md:90 says reraise(exception, stacktrace) is panic(exception), because fz carries no stacktraces and the second argument is accepted and ignored. exceptions.md:394 says __STACKTRACE__ binds to the empty list in rescue and catch clauses, where Elixir's holds the stacktrace.

Done when: an oracle fixture rescues inside a call chain and reads {module, function, arity, location} entries that match Elixir on interp, run and build.
title: A raised exception carries a stacktrace, and __STACKTRACE__ reads it, as in Elixir
